-- General settings
local RANGE = 5
local IMAGE_SIZE = 3
local COOLDOWN = 20

local tool = script.Parent

local anim
local toolPlr
local debounce = false

function round(x)
	
	-- Return rounded number
	if x >= 0 then
		return math.floor(x + 0.5)
	else
		return math.ceil(x - 0.5)
	end
	
end

script.ClientSpray.OnServerEvent:connect(function(plr, target, normal, pos, image)
	
	-- Check if tool is equipped and correct player
	if not debounce and tool.Parent ~= nil and tool.Parent.ClassName ~= "Backpack" and plr == toolPlr then
		debounce = true
		
		-- Check if in range
		if (pos - tool.Handle.Position).Magnitude <= RANGE and target.CanCollide == true and target.Transparency < 1 then
			
			-- Get target's rotation matrix
			local rotMatrix = target.CFrame - target.Position
			local invRotMatrix = rotMatrix:inverse()
			
			-- Get localized position and normal
			local localPos = pos - target.Position
			localPos = invRotMatrix * localPos
			local localNormal = invRotMatrix * normal
			localNormal = Vector3.new(round(localNormal.X), round(localNormal.Y), round(localNormal.Z))
			
			-- Calculate target surface
			local targetSurface
			if localNormal.Y == 1 then
				targetSurface = Enum.NormalId.Top
			elseif localNormal.Y == -1 then
				targetSurface = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
			elseif localNormal.X == -1 then
				targetSurface = Enum.NormalId.Left
			elseif localNormal.X == 1 then
				targetSurface = Enum.NormalId.Right
			elseif localNormal.Z == -1 then
				targetSurface = Enum.NormalId.Front
			elseif localNormal.Z == 1 then
				targetSurface = Enum.NormalId.Back
			end
			
			-- Check if okay to spray onto
			local okay = false
			local halfImageSize = IMAGE_SIZE / 2
			if targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Top or targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
				if localPos.X + halfImageSize < target.Size.X / 2 and localPos.X - halfImageSize > -target.Size.X / 2 and
				   localPos.Z + halfImageSize < target.Size.Z / 2 and localPos.Z - halfImageSize > -target.Size.Z / 2 then
					okay = true
				end
			elseif targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Left or targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Right then
				if localPos.Y + halfImageSize < target.Size.Y / 2 and localPos.Y - halfImageSize > -target.Size.Y / 2 and
				   localPos.Z + halfImageSize < target.Size.Z / 2 and localPos.Z - halfImageSize > -target.Size.Z / 2 then
					okay = true
				end
			elseif targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Front or targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Back then
				if localPos.X + halfImageSize < target.Size.X / 2 and localPos.X - halfImageSize > -target.Size.X / 2 and
				   localPos.Y + halfImageSize < target.Size.Y / 2 and localPos.Y - halfImageSize > -target.Size.Y / 2 then
					okay = true
				end
			end
			if okay then
				
				-- Create spray
				local sprayPart = Instance.new("Part")
				sprayPart.Name = "Spray"
				sprayPart.Transparency = 1
				sprayPart.CanCollide = false
				sprayPart.Anchored = true
				if targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Top then
					sprayPart.Size = Vector3.new(IMAGE_SIZE, 0.05, IMAGE_SIZE)
					pos = pos + Vector3.new(0, -0.02, 0)
				elseif targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
					sprayPart.Size = Vector3.new(IMAGE_SIZE, 0.05, IMAGE_SIZE)
					pos = pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.02, 0)
				elseif targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Left then
					sprayPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_SIZE)
					pos = pos + Vector3.new(0.02, 0, 0)
				elseif targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Right then
					sprayPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_SIZE)
					pos = pos + Vector3.new(-0.02, 0, 0)
				elseif targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Front then
					sprayPart.Size = Vector3.new(IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_SIZE, 0.05)
					pos = pos + Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.02)
				elseif targetSurface == Enum.NormalId.Back then
					sprayPart.Size = Vector3.new(IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_SIZE, 0.05)
					pos = pos + Vector3.new(0, 0, -0.02)
				end
				sprayPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * rotMatrix
				local decal = Instance.new("Decal", sprayPart)
				decal.Texture = image
				decal.Face = targetSurface
				sprayPart.Parent = workspace
				
				-- Play animation
				anim:Play()
				tool.Handle.Sound:Play()
				tool.EmitterPart.SprayEffect.Enabled = true
				spawn(function()
					wait(2.1)
					tool.Handle.Sound:Stop()
					tool.EmitterPart.SprayEffect.Enabled = false
				end)
				
				-- Wait until the cooldown is up
				script.StartTimer:FireClient(plr, COOLDOWN)
				wait(COOLDOWN)
				sprayPart:destroy()
						
			end
			
		end
		
		debounce = false
	end
	
end)

local pointService = game:GetService("PointsService")
local privateServer = (game.VIPServerOwnerId > 0)

function getRequiredXP(x)
	
	-- Calculate and return required XP for the given level
	return 40 + ((x - 1) * (320 / 99))
	
end

function levelUp(xp, lvl, prestige, plr)
	
	-- Check if the player has enough XP
	local requiredXP = getRequiredXP(lvl.Value) * math.pow(2, math.floor(prestige.Value / 10))
	if xp.Value >= requiredXP then
		
		-- Take away XP and increment level
		xp.Value = xp.Value - requiredXP
		lvl.Value = lvl.Value + 1
		
		-- Call level up again or prestige
		if lvl.Value < 100 then
			levelUp(xp, lvl, prestige, plr)
		elseif prestige.Value < 30 then
			xp.Value = 0
			lvl.Value = 1
			prestige.Value = prestige.Value + 1
			game.ReplicatedStorage.Interactions.Client.PrestigeUpgradeEffect:FireClient(plr, prestige.Value)
			local prestigeFirstName
			if prestige.Value >= 20 then
				prestigeFirstName = "Gold"
			elseif prestige.Value >= 10 then
				prestigeFirstName = "Silver"
			else
				prestigeFirstName = "Bronze"
			end
			local prestigeNumeral
			local moduloPrestige = prestige.Value % 10
			if moduloPrestige == 1 then
				prestigeNumeral = "I"
			elseif moduloPrestige == 2 then
				prestigeNumeral = "II"
			elseif moduloPrestige == 3 then
				prestigeNumeral = "III"
			elseif moduloPrestige == 4 then
				prestigeNumeral = "IV"
			elseif moduloPrestige == 5 then
				prestigeNumeral = "V"
			elseif moduloPrestige == 6 then
				prestigeNumeral = "VI"
			elseif moduloPrestige == 7 then
				prestigeNumeral = "VII"
			elseif moduloPrestige == 8 then
				prestigeNumeral = "VIII"
			elseif moduloPrestige == 9 then
				prestigeNumeral = "IX"
			else
				prestigeNumeral = "X"
			end
			game.ReplicatedStorage.Interactions.Client.ShowChatMessage:FireAllClients(nil, plr.Name .. " prestiged to " .. prestigeFirstName .. " " .. prestigeNumeral .. "!")
		end
		
	end
	
end

	part.Anchored = true
	knife.Anchored = false

	local cframeInverse0 = part.CFrame:inverse()
	local cframeInverse1 = knife.CFrame:inverse()

	aWeld.AncestryChanged:connect(function()

	aWeld.Part0 = part

function getRandomCaseItem(case, plr)
	
	-- Get all items from the case
	local possibleSkins = case.Contents:GetChildren()
	local godlies = {}
	local legendaries = {}
	local rares = {}
	local uncommons = {}
	local commons = {}
	for _, i in pairs(possibleSkins) do
		if i.Value.Rarity.Value == "Common" then
			table.insert(commons, i.Value)
		elseif i.Value.Rarity.Value == "Uncommon" then
			table.insert(uncommons, i.Value)
		elseif i.Value.Rarity.Value == "Rare" then
			table.insert(rares, i.Value)
		elseif i.Value.Rarity.Value == "Legendary" then
			table.insert(legendaries, i.Value)
		elseif i.Value.Rarity.Value == "Godly" then
			table.insert(godlies, i.Value)
		end
	end
	
	-- Get rarity values
	local commonVal = case.CommonChance.Value * 10000
	local uncommonVal = case.UncommonChance.Value * 10000 + commonVal
	local rareVal = case.RareChance.Value * 10000 + uncommonVal
	local legendaryVal = case.LegendaryChance.Value * 10000 + rareVal
	local godlyVal = case.GodlyChance.Value * 10000 + legendaryVal
	local randVal = math.random(1, (case.CommonChance.Value + case.UncommonChance.Value + case.RareChance.Value + case.LegendaryChance.Value + case.GodlyChance.Value) * 10000)
	
	-- See which to use
	if randVal < commonVal then
		return commons[math.random(1, #commons)]
	elseif randVal < uncommonVal then
		return uncommons[math.random(1, #uncommons)]
	elseif randVal < rareVal then
		return rares[math.random(1, #rares)]
	elseif randVal < legendaryVal then
		return legendaries[math.random(1, #legendaries)]
	else
		plr.Achievements.GodlyUnboxes.Value = plr.Achievements.GodlyUnboxes.Value + 1
		return godlies[math.random(1, #godlies)]
	end
	
end

	if not plr.Settings.CanSave.Value then

function getInvTable(folder)
	
	-- Get data
	local data = {}
	for _, i in pairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		for _=1, i.Value do
			table.insert(data, i.Name)
		end
	end
	return data
	
end

function fillUsingInvTable(folder, data)
	
	-- Clear folder
	for _, i in pairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		i:destroy()
	end
	
	-- Create a value for each
	for _, i in pairs(data) do
		if folder.Name == "RevolverSkins" and i == "Blizzard" then
			i = "Chiller"
		end
		if game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(folder.Name):FindFirstChild(i) ~= nil then
			if folder:FindFirstChild(i) ~= nil then
				local val = folder:FindFirstChild(i)
				val.Value = val.Value + 1
			else
				local val = Instance.new("IntValue", folder)
				val.Name = i
				val.Value = 1
			end
		end
	end
	
end

function isCurrentlySaving(plrID)
	
	-- Check if so
	for _, i in pairs(plrsSaving) do
		if i == plrID then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
	
end

function markAsSaving(plrID)
	
	-- Mark it
	if not isCurrentlySaving(plrID) then
		table.insert(plrsSaving, plrID)
	end
	
end

function unmarkAsSaving(plrID)
	
	-- Unmark it
	for n, i in pairs(plrsSaving) do
		if i == plrID then
			table.remove(plrsSaving, n)
			break
		end
	end
	
end
